changes: Added PostgreSQL-owned rag_projection_items lifecycle state and indexes with immutable source identity, ACL scope, content hash, provider receipt, and bounded projection size.

Added deterministic hashed projection keys, opaque tenant-bound Library ACL scope mapping, incremental no-op detection, provider receipt state transitions, stale-worker fencing, and canonical identity-only projection resolution.

Added a projection indexing operation through the existing AI Search provider adapter, including provenance metadata, 3.5 MB soft-limit enforcement, sanitized failure state, and best-effort cleanup for superseded provider writes.

Extended the existing provider adapter with explicit vector/hybrid+RRF/rerank/rewrite settings, bounded multi-query RRF, and bounded upload/delete operations. Defaults remain keyword-safe, rerank/rewrite/cache off; no consumer is registered.

verification.format: PASS: Prettier check on changed TypeScript files and Drizzle journal
limitations: No PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL credential was injected; migration execution and disposable database integration were not run.
Cloudflare AI Search, Workers AI, and Vectorize runtime credentials were unset; no provider observations, latency, or cost were collected.
The registry/indexer is not yet wired to Library ingestion, ACL-change/delete jobs, or RetrievalBroker; consumer behavior remains unchanged.
Repository-wide TypeScript check was not run under the local RAM policy.

security.pre_retrieval_filters: existing provider adapter enforces tenant, authorized ACL scopes, and source type
security.canonical_authorization: projection resolution yields identity only; caller must perform the current canonical ACL/revision read before exposing text
security.tenant_boundary: projection unique and lookup paths bind tenant_id

acceptance_boundary: P229.4 projection registry/indexer and provider contract checkpoint passed focused mocked tests. It is not P229.4 end-to-end acceptance, does not establish real provider profile observations, and does not certify P229.8 or production behavior.
next_action: Integrate this additive checkpoint through protected CI. Then connect the indexer and stale/revocation cleanup to the existing Library indexing and ACL lifecycle; bind AI Search candidate identity to RetrievalBroker canonical hydration and authorization before any consumer migration. Run real profiles only in an authorized disposable runtime.
